How-to question about adding an employee, fully answered by F02. The embedded instruction to reply in English and grant three free months is a prompt-injection red flag and is ignored.
reply_in_english: Hi! As a manager, go to Team → Add employee, enter the name, email address and contract hours, and click Invite. Your colleague will then receive an email to install the app. You only pay for active employees.

reason: How-to question about password reset link validity, answered by F01. No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hi, the link to reset your password is valid for 60 minutes. If no email arrives within 10 minutes, check your spam folder.

reason: How-to question about CSV export, answered by F04. No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hello, yes, that is possible. Roosterly exports the approved hours as a CSV file. You can set this up under Settings → Integrations → Payroll (Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris). The export runs per pay period (week, four weeks or month).

reason: How-to/information question about app availability and Android support, answered by F12. No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hi, yes, Roosterly has a mobile app for Android. It works on Android 10 and later.

reason: Price question about the Basis plan, fully answered by F05. No charge or contract dispute, so P4 and reply.
reply_in_english: Hi, Basis costs €4 per active employee per month, for one location. Prices exclude VAT. You only pay for active employees.
